meta.title: Game Sensitivity Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Convert mouse sensitivity between CS2, Valorant, Apex, Overwatch, and 13 more games. Precise cm/360 math.
sensConverterDesc: Enter your sensitivity and DPI — conversion updates automatically.
cm360Desc: Distance your mouse must travel for one full 360° rotation
steps_sensitivity-converter_1Desc: Choose your game, input your current sensitivity, mouse DPI, and any game-specific settings like FOV or aim type (hipfire/ADS/scoped).
steps_sensitivity-converter_2Desc: Select the target game or enter desired settings. The converter calculates the equivalent sensitivity for consistent aim feel across games.
steps_sensitivity-converter_3Desc: Copy the converted sensitivity value and paste it into your game settings. Fine-tune ±10% in-game to find your personal comfort zone.
